title: THE DOOR
message: An opening is not a promise. It is enough that it exists.
meaning:
The Door is access without certainty.

Something that was enclosed is now open, but the card refuses to show what waits beyond it. The possibility matters before the destination does.

You do not need to know where an opening leads in order to recognize that your situation is no longer closed.
imageAlt: An open door casting light into a vast dark interior
